sources.total_units: RHP p449 ('Units issued and outstanding after the Offer 3,400,000,000'; pre-Offer 3,161,000,000).
sources.offer: RHP cover p1 ('340,500,000 Units ... ₹100 per Unit aggregating to ₹34,050 million, consisting of a fresh issuance of 239,000,000 Units ... ₹23,900 million and an offer for sale of 101,500,000 Units ... ₹10,150 million'; Offer = 10.01% of post-Offer Units). = ₹3,405cr (₹2,390cr fresh + ₹1,015cr OFS).
sources.sponsor_pct: RHP p449 ('our Sponsor together with our Sponsor Group will hold 2,815,534,147 Units, aggregating to 82.81% of the total Units issued'). Sponsor alone (Bagmane Realty and Infrastructure LLP) = 79.25% (2,694,633,237).
sources.gav: REIT_AUM_MSF_sources/bagmane.json ipo (Final_Offer_Document (RHP).pdf p39; Total Market Value ₹402,634.9 mn ≈ ₹40,260 cr)

notes: Sponsor % = Sponsor + Sponsor Group, post-issue = 82.81% (stated in RHP).
Market cap at IPO = ₹100 × 3,400,000,000 = ₹34,000 cr. % sold = ₹3,405cr ÷ ₹34,000cr = 10.01% (matches RHP's stated 10.01% of post-Offer units).
RHP dated 11 May 2026; listed 14 May 2026. Sponsor is Bagmane Realty and Infrastructure LLP.
